items.translation: sources - 应用程序的源（Spring 配置）

items.source: Returns a fully configured SpringApplication that is ready to run.
items.translation: 返回一个已完全配置并准备运行的SpringApplication。

items.source: Adds BootstrapRegistryInitializer instances that can be used to initialize the BootstrapRegistry.
items.translation: 添加可用于初始化BootstrapRegistry的BootstrapRegistryInitializer实例。

items.source: Flag to indicate if the ApplicationConversionService should be added to the application context's Environment.
items.translation: 用于指示是否将 ApplicationConversionService 添加到应用程序上下文的 Environment 的标志。

items.source: Sets the Banner instance which will be used to print the banner when no static banner file is provided.
items.translation: 设置 Banner` 实例，用于在没有提供静态横幅文件时打印横幅。

items.source: the fully configured SpringApplication.
items.translation: 完全配置的SpringApplication。

items.source: defaultProperties - the properties to set.
items.translation: defaultProperties - 要设置的属性。

items.source: the new sibling builder
items.translation: 新的兄弟构建器

items.source: Configure the ApplicationStartup to be used with the ApplicationContext for collecting startup metrics.
items.translation: 配置 ApplicationStartup 以与 ApplicationContext 配合使用，用于收集启动指标。

items.source: Add some initializers to the application (applied to the ApplicationContext before any bean definitions are loaded).
items.translation: 向应用程序添加一些初始化器（在加载任何 Bean 定义之前应用于ApplicationContext）。

items.source: Sets if the created ApplicationContext should have a shutdown hook registered.
items.translation: 设置是否应为创建的ApplicationContext注册关闭钩子。

items.source: Flag to indicate that command line arguments should be added to the environment.
items.translation: 标志，指示应将命令行参数添加到环境中。

items.source:
Whether to allow circular references between beans and automatically try to resolve
them.
items.translation: 是否允许 Bean 之间的循环引用并自动尝试解析它们。

items.source: Accessor for the current application.
items.translation: 当前应用程序的访问器。

items.source:
Bean name generator for automatically generated bean names in the application
context.
items.translation: 用于在应用程序上下文中自动生成 Bean 名称的 Bean 名称生成器。

items.source: Accessor for the current application context.
items.translation: 当前应用程序上下文的访问器。

items.source: Explicitly set the factory used to create the application context.
items.translation: 显式设置用于创建应用程序上下文的工厂。

items.source: Environment for the application context.
items.translation: 应用程序上下文的环境。

items.source:
Prefix that should be applied when obtaining configuration properties from the
system environment.
items.translation: 从系统环境获取配置属性时应应用的前缀。

items.source: Flag to control whether the application should be initialized lazily.
items.translation: 控制应用程序是否应懒式初始化的标志。

items.source: Flag to indicate the startup information should be logged.
items.translation: 标志，指示是否应记录启动信息。

items.source: Fixes the main application class that is used to anchor the startup messages.
items.translation: 修复用于锚定启动消息的主应用程序类。

items.source: Add an already running parent context to an existing application.
items.translation: 向现有应用程序添加一个正在运行的父上下文。

items.source: Add to the active Spring profiles for this app (and its parent and children).
items.translation: 添加到此应用（及其父级和子级）的当前活动 Spring 配置文件中。

items.source:
Default properties for the environment.Multiple calls to this method are cumulative
and will not clear any previously set properties.
items.translation: 环境默认属性。多次调用此方法是累积的，不会清除之前设置的任何属性。

items.source: Create a sibling application (one with the same parent).
items.translation: 创建具有相同父级的兄弟应用程序。

items.source: Add more sources (configuration classes and components) to this application.
items.translation: 向此应用程序添加更多源（配置类和组件）。

items.source:
If your needs are simpler, consider using the static convenience methods in
SpringApplication instead.
items.translation: 如果您的需求更简单，可以考虑使用 SpringApplication 中的静态便捷方法。

items.source: Creates a new SpringApplication instance from the given sources using the given ResourceLoader. Subclasses may override in order to provide a custom subclass of SpringApplication.
items.translation: 使用给定的 ResourceLoader` 从给定源创建一个新的 SpringApplication` 实例。子类可以重写此方法以提供自定义的 SpringApplication` 子类。

items.source: Creates a new SpringApplication instance from the given sources using the given ResourceLoader.
items.translation: 使用给定的 ResourceLoader 从给定源创建一个新的 SpringApplication 实例。

items.source: Add some listeners to the application (listening for SpringApplication events as well as regular Spring events once the context is running). Any listeners that are also ApplicationContextInitializer will be added to the initializers automatically.
items.translation: 向应用程序添加一些监听器（用于监听 SpringApplication 事件，以及在上下文运行后监听常规 Spring 事件）。任何同时也是 ApplicationContextInitializer 的监听器，将自动添加到 initializers 中。

items.source: Returns a fully configured SpringApplication that is ready to run. Any parent that has been configured will be run with the given args.
items.translation: 返回一个已完全配置并准备运行的SpringApplication。任何已配置的父类都将使用给定的args运行。

items.source: Create a sibling application (one with the same parent). A side effect of calling this method is that the current application (and its parent) are started without any arguments if they are not already running. To supply arguments when starting the current application and its parent use sibling(Class[], String...) instead.
items.translation: 创建一个兄弟应用程序（具有相同父级）。调用此方法的一个副作用是，如果当前应用程序及其父级尚未运行，则不带任何参数启动它们。要在启动当前应用程序及其父级时提供参数，请使用 sibling(Class[], String...) 代替。

items.source: Default properties for the environment in the form key=value or key:value. Multiple calls to this method are cumulative and will not clear any previously set properties.
items.translation: 环境中默认属性的格式为 `key=value` 或 `key:value`。多次调用此方法是累积的，不会清除之前设置的任何属性。

items.source: ResourceLoader for the application context. If a custom class loader is needed, this is where it would be added.
items.translation: ResourceLoader 用于应用程序上下文。如果需要自定义类加载器，此处即为添加位置。

items.source:
Create an application context (and its parent if specified) with the command line
args provided. The parent is run first with the same arguments if it has not yet
been started.
items.translation: 使用提供的命令行参数创建应用程序上下文（如果指定了父上下文，则同时创建其父上下文）。如果父上下文尚未启动，则首先使用相同的参数运行它。

items.source:
Create a child application with the provided sources. Default args and environment
are copied down into the child, but everything else is a clean sheet.
items.translation: 使用提供的源文件创建子应用程序。默认参数和环境变量会被复制到子程序中，但其他所有内容都是全新的空白状态。

items.source:
Add a parent application with the provided sources. Default args and environment
are copied up into the parent, but everything else is a clean sheet.
items.translation: 添加一个包含所提供源代码的父应用程序。默认参数和环境变量会被复制到父应用程序中，但其他所有内容都是全新的。

items.source:
Create a sibling application (one with the same parent). A side effect of calling
this method is that the current application (and its parent) are started if they
are not already running.
items.translation: 创建一个兄弟应用程序（即具有相同父级应用程序的应用程序）。调用此方法的一个副作用是，如果当前应用程序及其父级尚未运行，则启动它们。

items.source:
Flag to explicitly request a specific type of web application. Auto-detected based
on the classpath if not set.
items.translation: 用于显式请求特定类型 Web 应用的标志。如果未设置，则根据类路径自动检测。

items.source:
Default properties for the environment. Multiple calls to this method are
cumulative and will not clear any previously set properties.
items.translation: 环境默认属性。多次调用此方法是累积的，不会清除之前设置的任何属性。
